key_finding: Intuitive Machines' six-director board is the deepest NASA / national-security / aerospace pedigree set on any small-cap space company at this scale. Class III chairman Dr. Kamal Ghaffarian (co-founder of Stinger Ghaffarian Technologies + Axiom Space + X Energy + Quantum Space + PTX) is one of the most prolific deep-tech / space industry founder-chairman figures of his generation. Class III CEO Stephen Altemus came from NASA Johnson Space Center where he served as Deputy Director and led the Columbia Reconstruction Director role after the 2003 disaster. Class I directors William Liquori (retired Lieutenant General, US Space Force Chief Strategy and Resourcing Officer) and Robert Masson (ex-Raytheon/Naval Aviator/Harvard MBA CFO; Audit Chair) provide military-aerospace and finance pedigree. Class II director Michael Blitzer (Kingstown Capital founder, USA Rare Earth Chairman, Merlin Labs lead independent, Inflection Point SPAC sponsor — the original IPO vehicle that took LUNR public via de-SPAC) is the financial-engineering anchor and chairs Strategic Transactions. Class II director Nicole Seligman (ex-President Sony Entertainment + Sony Corporation of America + 9 years EVP and Global GC Sony + clerked for Justice Thurgood Marshall + Williams & Connolly litigation partner + Harvard College magna + Harvard Law magna + OpenAI director + Meira GTx Holdings director) is one of the most credentialed corporate-governance directors on any US listed company at LUNR's market cap. The executive team is rebuilt around the Lanteris acquisition: Tim Crain (Co-founder, CTO from Feb 2026) carries the NASA aerospace-engineering pedigree; Peter McGrath (CFO from September 2024) came from 31 years at Boeing; Chris Johnson (President of Lanteris from January 2026) was CEO of Lanteris and President of Boeing Satellite Systems International.

ceo_president_director.framing: Altemus is the rare working space-engineering executive who built a private space company out of NASA institutional credibility. The Columbia Reconstruction Director role is the most operationally-significant single credential on the public space-CEO landscape — running the response to the loss of a Space Shuttle is among the most disciplined aerospace engineering management roles in modern history. The combined Embry Riddle aeronautical + UCF engineering management pedigree, the JSC Deputy Director seat, and the 25+ years at NASA before founding Intuitive Machines are why NASA Johnson Space Center remains his most important institutional relationship.

board_composition_observation: LUNR's six-director board is structurally configured for a NASA-contractor + national-security-procurement + space-systems-acquisition operating company at the pre-revenue-scale and through the early-revenue-ramp phases of the business. The Ghaffarian + Altemus founder-pair is anchored by the LtGen Liquori national-security credential, the Masson Naval-Academy + Harvard MBA + Raytheon aerospace-finance credential, the Blitzer Kingstown Capital + Inflection Point SPAC + Strategic Transactions Chair financial-engineering credential, and the Seligman Sony + OpenAI + Harvard Law corporate-governance credential. There is no separate sitting space-industry CEO peer on the board (no Tory Bruno / Bill Anderson-grade direct space-industry CEO peer). The composition is calibrated for governance through the Lanteris integration and the NASA CLPS task-order execution rather than for executing a transformational outbound M&A.
